maintained_predicate: Ordinary POSIX Python must match a supported physical system installation and the executable plus all ancestors through / must be UID0-owned and not group/world writable.
actual_observation: The current namespace exposes / as UID1000, mode0755 and writable to the executing principal. Default Python3.12 and system Python3.13 are UID65534; the dedicated existing continuity transport is absent.
harness_nuance: The fixture deliberately strips IMPLEMENTAUDIT_* overrides. PATH is retained, but a different PATH cannot cure the complete ancestry failure here.
smallest_valid_next_input: An actual supported POSIX or Windows execution environment satisfying the unchanged custody route. No wrapper, UID relabel, invented transport or synthetic namespace is supplied.
